subject: Zaun unit identity contract for art: what every line must look like, what must differ, and what may never appear.

armyIdentity.theme: An industrial undercity that fights with patched bodies, pressurised chemistry and brute strength: cheap street muscle, self-repairing ravagers, chemical constructs, industrial enforcers, charged alchemists, long-tool veterans and a two-hex laboratory predator.
strengths: Self-repairing ravagers and a two-hex regenerating apex that outlasts attritional exchanges.
An industrial long-tool line that strikes over an empty hex and is not answered by retaliation.
A charged alchemist that softens one target per battle.
A mechanical construct line with no morale dependency.
weaknesses: No flying or teleporting line: every stack walks the same native movement routes.
Only one ranged line, and it sits at tier three with finite ammunition.
Most troops have no damage reduction, no retaliation suppression and no sustain besides tier two and tier seven.
The tier-one line is fragile, and the tier-five line spends a whole action on a single debuff.

lines.lore: Undercity street labour and improvised street fighting; the ranks are project fiction and are not any champion.
lines.silhouette: Compact human in a patched work coat, wrapped fists and a short iron pipe; the upgrade adds a scrap shoulder plate and a corroded pipe head.
lines.equipment: Pipe, wrapped hands, satchel and patched coat. No shields, no plate, no banners.
lines.palette: Dull brown work cloth, rust, one dull accent. The upgrade adds a brighter scrap accent but keeps the same body language.
lines.distinctness: Must not read as a Demacian foot soldier, a Noxian legionary or a Pit Lord.

lines.lore: Alchemically altered scavengers; the alteration is a livelihood under coercion, not a moral verdict.
lines.silhouette: Hunched, heavy-shouldered brawler with a leather restraint harness and an oversized hook; the upgrade adds bolted arm braces and a broader stance.
lines.equipment: Hook, restraint belts, padded vest, dosing vials at the belt.
lines.palette: Sickly green-grey skin tones, brown harness, dull brass fittings. Never green-glowing heroic.
lines.distinctness: Must not read as an orc, a goblin or a Demacian infantryman; the harness and hook are the read.

lines.lore: A chemtech pressure frame built to haul and fire; the machine is a tool, not a person.
lines.silhouette: Riveted pumping frame with a visible pressure tank, splayed mechanical legs and a physical nozzle arm; the upgrade is the same frame with strapped tanks and heavier plating.
lines.equipment: Pressure tank, valve wheel, nozzle, rivets, exhaust pipe. No faces, no eyes, no humanoid head.
lines.palette: Rust, iron grey, oxidised copper and one warning stripe colour. No purple hextech glow: Zaun works with chemtech, not Piltover hextech.
lines.distinctness: Must not read as a golem of another faction, a robot or a Wizard tower construct; the nozzle and tank are the read.

lines.lore: Chemical-baron enforcement crews in industrial braces; the augmentation is prosthetic, never a loss of self.
lines.silhouette: Human-sized figure in bulky industrial braces with a heavy cleaver; the upgrade adds a ribbed shield plate, a wider cleaver arc and a braced stance.
lines.equipment: Heavy cleaver, brace frames, stained leather apron, a chem-baron brand on the harness. The upgrade needs a group attack animation for its wide sweep.
lines.palette: Oiled leather, dark iron, brass buckles, one crimson brand accent.
lines.distinctness: Must not read as a Noxian axe Reckoner, a Demacian duelist or a knight; the industrial braces are the read. The upgrade sweeps sideways into the neighbours, it does not ignore armour and it does not attack behind the target.

lines.lore: Field chemists serving a chemical baron; they fight with reagents, not with blades.
lines.silhouette: Lean figure with a chemical satchel, caged flasks on the back and a hooked staff; the upgrade adds a filter mask and capped hoses.
lines.equipment: Satchel, caged flasks, hooked staff, filter mask on the upgrade. The cast is a thrown or blown reagent, not a spell gesture.
lines.palette: Stained canvas, copper tubing, amber glass, one deep crimson reagent.
lines.distinctness: Must not read as a Necropolis alchemist or a Noxian hemomancer; the caged flasks and the mask are the read. The agent fights in melee and has no gun, and it never leaves a gas field behind.

lines.lore: Volunteers and coerced workers in braced augmentation frames; the human face stays visible.
lines.silhouette: Heavy infantry in a scrap cuirass with hydraulic braces over wool and leather, head uncovered, carrying a telescopic clamp tool; the upgrade is a heavier braced frame with a longer clamp head and the same exposed face.
lines.equipment: Scrap cuirass, hydraulic braces, a long industrial clamp or salvage shear, patched cloth. Never a full helmet: the face must remain visible. The tool extends in the attack animation; the footprint stays one hex.
lines.palette: Wool brown, oiled steel, one worn crimson strap.
lines.distinctness: Must not read as a Dwarf, a Legionnaire or an undead; the exposed human face and the hydraulic clamp are the read. The reach is a tool attack over one empty hex, not a hook, not a shield wall and not a defensive stance.

lines.lore: A laboratory beast grown past its intended shape; the animal is a subject of Zaun's industry, not a demon.
lines.silhouette: Low, muscular, four-legged predator with stitched hide, matte chemical scars, grasping forelimbs and a heavy head; the upgrade adds horn ridges, a heavier frame and longer grasping limbs.
lines.equipment: Stitching, chemical scarring, no armour and no rider. The body reads as two hexes wide. The upgrade's grab needs a group attack animation for the all-around reach.
lines.palette: Raw hide brown, grey scarring, dull crimson seams. No wings, no stone, no metal plating.
lines.distinctness: Must not read as a dragon, a behemoth, a demon or a unicorn; it is a stitched animal. Its multi-target strike grabs everything around it, it does not breathe chemicals and it does not use the rear-hex breath geometry of a two-hex attacker.

presentation.renderingLanguage: Heroes III native painted, low three-quarter view, flat readable silhouette, strong outline, limited painted shading, alpha background. This is the original game's visual grammar, not its content.
presentation.nativeSizes: Battle frame 450x400 with pivot (197, 266); adventure map sprite 96x64; large portrait 58x64; small portrait 32x32; attack side 64x64.
forbidden: No original Heroes III sprite, recolour, trace or partial reuse.
No Demacia or Noxus art, rig, guide or compiled output as a base layer.
No placeholder blocks, primitive renders or silhouette-only stand-ins.
No hextech blue-green glow, no Piltover heraldry and no official emblem.
No text, logo or watermark inside any image.

gameplayVerification: Not started. Every line is an authored configuration; identity acceptance requires the checksum-bound native-size review recorded in assets/reviews.
balanceClaim: None. See design/creature-balance.json for the estimates and the open findings.
